scope: Installed R-derived production generator; historical Camera accuracy and requested future paired browser checks. Research, not public release acceptance.
qualification: Reused elections; source collection and manual mixed-wave point references differ from the selected fitted procedure. Monte Carlo intervals use whole draws and independent model streams, conditional on these fixed cases, not uncertainty about future elections. Municipal summary bias cancels compositionally; inspect group bias.

policy.turnout: preserve mapped historical valid fraction; no retrospective turnout adjustment
policy.unmapped: non-valid support, with no synthetic residual list
policy.newLists: latest eligible explicitly named poll in the reviewed source collection; no invented Other allocation; absent evidence remains zero and is reported
policy.pollRefresh: latest eligible named observation per future list; preserve baseline proportions in unreported remainder; legacy poll-reference measurement path
policy.defaultJointWeight: equal weights for recognized constituent identities, normalized by the unchanged legacy engine; these are user assumptions, not inferred historical vote splits

supplementalPolls.assumption: Azione/+Europa 5.3% split 70/30; sum Azione and IV for the conditional future joint list
Azione 3.1 + LibDem 0.6 combined for requested future ticket; unspecified small parties retain historical relative support

notes: Overrides the provisional 2026 row in legacy-comparison-policy.json. The Supermedia HTML table separates SWG's joint LibDem/Ora answer; do not treat that separation as two measured shares.
Ora uses the latest separately identified eligible observation found: Youtrend/Sky, published 8 October, fieldwork 5-6 October. It is not a 0.6% SWG observation.
Azione/PLD combines SWG's 19 October Azione 3.1% and Youtrend's latest separately identified PLD 1.1%. This mixed-wave point is a user scenario assumption.
Generic reviewed compact-source polls supplement these rows. Conditional coalition questions are excluded. No future outcome is used.

Senate TAA named joint candidate groups inherit only their explicitly named future identities. Approximate deterministic splits follow known 2022 Camera TAA relative strengths; they are user assumptions, not observed internal Senate counts. Wider civic identities receive no invented separate component. VdA broad alliances remain unmapped, with separately labelled scenario references.

polls.verification: Generic party estimates cross-checked against https://sondaggibidimedia.com/sondaggio-swg-19-ottobre-2026/ (later mirror, not the information availability date). SWG original publication date verified in the pinned pcm-14363 manifest. PLD addition is separately sourced above.
